system.description: Stormi hears the Stormkelt’s wish and grants a chosen character incredible strength. The recipient (the dimwalker or someone of their choosing) receives the exceptional characteristic of Strength +8 for the ability’s duration. Any other allies (including the dimwalker, if the ability targets someone else) within range of the Stormkelt also receive the exceptional characteristic of Strength +4 for the ability’s duration.
